content:
Sam Chen: Heads up — noticed a P95 latency spike on the canary after today's merge (0f3a2b). Dedicated-us-west-2-3 showing p95 ~420ms vs baseline ~120ms. Looks related to KV eviction + kernel selector change for seq len ~1024.
Maya Patel: saw the same alert. Canary rollout started ~1912343000. CI perf jobs were green though.
Oliver Ruiz: can you bisect quickly @Maya? suspect the kernel selector heuristic change in that merge.
Maya Patel: running perf-bisect now: ```./infra/perf-bisect --range 0f3a2b^..0f3a2b --profile=canary --target=dedicated-us-west-2-3``` will iterate per-commit, ~12 runs.
ci-bot: perf-bisect queued (id:5521). I'll post results when a regression is found.
Maya Patel: first pass complete — regression surfaces at commit ab7d9c (batching + selector refactor). p95 jumps only when seq_len >= 768 and KV hit rate < 0.6.
Sam Chen: that matches flamegraphs — KV eviction thrash + a different kernel chosen increased per-token work. We need to stop the canary rollout. @DevOps Bot can you pause?
DevOps Bot: pausing rollout for release/v1.11 now. Canary traffic shifted back to previous variant. :white_check_mark: 
Tess Nguyen: I'll open a revert PR for ab7d9c to unblock rollouts, but patch might revert several unrelated refactors. Prefer to cherry-pick a targeted fix if we can.
Oliver Ruiz: agree, let's craft a minimal patch: (1) tighten eviction policy for KV cache under low-hit scenarios, (2) fallback to old kernel when sequence length distribution > 512. Maya, can you prototype?
Maya Patel: prototyping. Patch snippet: ```diff
- if (selector.prefers_new_kernel(seq_len)) return new_kernel;
+ if (seq_len > 512 && kv_hit_rate < 0.7) return old_kernel;
``` 
Maya Patel: ran the patched build on staging: p95 -> 128ms, p99 -> 210ms, token throughput matches baseline.
Tess Nguyen: opened PR #4823 cherry-pick of targeted patch into release/v1.11 and main. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4823. Added test that simulates low KV-hit + long seq.
ci-bot: perf-check for PR #4823 started. Results: p95 <= baseline + 5%. All perf tests passed.
Sam Chen: great. @DevOps Bot can you start a canary rollout of PR #4823 to the paused group? We want to validate on the same dedicated pool.
DevOps Bot: canary started for PR #4823 against dedicated-us-west-2-3.
Maya Patel: running end-to-end profiler during canary: ```./tools/profiler --target=dedicated-us-west-2-3 --trace kv,selector``` quick output: "kv_evictions_before: 7/s -> 1/s; chosen_kernel: old_kernel"
Oliver Ruiz: looks good. If canary stays green for 30m we'll promote. Anyone object to skipping full revert?
Tess Nguyen: skipping revert is fine; revert would lose other fixes. We'll backport cherry-pick to v1.10 as well. Creating backport PR now.
Sam Chen: thumbs up. Remember to add a regression entry in perf-regressions board and note the interplay (selector + eviction).
Maya Patel: canary passed 45m. p95 stable ~130ms. Merging cherry-pick to main and release/v1.11; backport PR created for v1.10 (#4824).
Tess Nguyen: merged and tagged hotfix-1.11.1. CI green.
Sam Chen: closing the thread — no rollback needed, cherry-pick fixed the critical path. We'll draft a short postmortem: root cause = aggressive kernel selector change combined with KV eviction threshold that didn't account for long-sequence workloads. Action items: add staging perf test for seq_len 512-2048, add kv-hit synthetic tests, add gating for kernel selector changes.
Maya Patel: adding action items to the sprint board. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
